interpretation: Temporal steps include real environmental variation and do not isolate sensor bias. Acceptance targets are diagnostic, never enforced by rescaling.
sensor_ratio_definition: sum of same-cell same-month counts / sum of paired MODIS; complete source months only
temporal_step_definition: median of knot-year monthly totals / median of same-month totals in each of three previous years; all three required
validation_design: 2024-2025 excluded from fitting; v1 holdout diagnostic informed the v2 sparse-count correction, so this is not an untouched final benchmark. A new prospective test is required.
warnings: Cell estimates allocate tile predictions by VIIRS activity; cell accuracy is reported separately from tile and regional accuracy.
